# `@videojs/spf/hls/features/error`

Source: [src/playback/engines/hls/features/error.ts](../../../src/playback/engines/hls/features/error.ts)

## errorFeature

Collects the errors the other features report into `state.errors`, per source. Without it, reporting is a no-op.

### Behaviors

1. [collectErrors](../behaviors/collect-errors.md#collecterrors)

### State

| Key | Type | Declared by | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `errors` | `SvtaError[] \| undefined` | [collectErrors](../behaviors/collect-errors.md#collecterrors) | Conditions reported during playback, in the order encountered — appended by whichever behavior detects one (`emitError`), owned and cleared per source by `collectErrors`. Carries no severity: which of these is fatal is decided above the engine, at the adapter. See `internal/design/spf/features/errors.md`. |
| `presentation` | `MaybeResolvedPresentation \| undefined` | [collectErrors](../behaviors/collect-errors.md#collecterrors) | No description. |
